entries.wording: Parcel has been prepared by the sender
entries.note: The sender made the label; Allegro One has not handled the parcel yet.

entries.wording: Parcel has been dispatched
entries.note: The sender dropped the parcel off.

entries.wording: Parcel has been dispatched at point
entries.note: The sender dropped the parcel off at a pickup point.

entries.wording: Parcel has been picked up by the courier
entries.note: The courier collected the parcel from the sender.

entries.wording: Parcel has been picked up from parcel locker by courier
entries.note: A courier collected the sender's drop-off from a locker.

entries.wording: Parcel has been picked up from point by courier
entries.note: A courier collected the sender's drop-off from a pickup point.

entries.wording: Courier has transferred the parcel to the warehouse
Parcel has been dispatched to its destination point
entries.note: The parcel left for the locker, point or branch serving the recipient.

entries.wording: Parcel has been accepted at the sorting center
Parcel has been accepted at the delivery center
entries.note: Seen on Allegro Delivery parcels.

entries.wording: Parcel has been accepted at the destination center
entries.note: Seen on Allegro Delivery parcels.

entries.wording: Dispatched from sorting center
entries.note: Listed by /ad/tracking; /one/tracking leaves it out.

entries.wording: Parcel has been accepted at the branch
Parcel has been redirected to a different point
entries.note: Follows the recipient's choice of another point.

entries.wording: Parcel may be delivered with delay
entries.note: A notice; the parcel keeps moving.

entries.wording: Parcel delivery time has been arranged with the recipient
entries.note: A notice; the parcel keeps moving.

entries.wording: Parcel has been released for delivery
entries.note: Also before a locker delivery.

entries.wording: No space in the parcel locker
entries.note: The courier found the locker full and took the parcel back.

entries.wording: Destination pick-up point is not available
entries.note: Polish: "Wybrany punkt docelowy jest niedostępny". The courier takes the parcel back to the branch and tries again.

entries.wording: Recipient has refused to accept
entries.note: After the parcel was released for delivery; the parcel seen with it was delivered later, so the refusal ended an attempt, not the delivery.

entries.wording: Notice
entries.note: Polish: "Awizo". Nobody took the parcel at the door and a notice was left.

entries.wording: Parcel is waiting for an alternative point indication
entries.note: The recipient is asked to choose another point.

entries.wording: Parcel is awaiting pick-up
Parcel is awaiting pick-up — pick-up deadline is about to expire
Time for pick-up has been extended
Time for parcel pick-up has expired
entries.note: A return to the sender follows.

entries.wording: No parcel
entries.note: The parcel was not where a scan expected it; later scans can find it again.

entries.wording: Parcel has been lost
entries.note: Later scans can find the parcel again.

entries.wording: Parcel has been returned to the sender
Parcel has been delivered
entries.note: Also when the recipient collects the parcel from a locker or point.
